transcript: I'm handling a customer complaint email. I open the email and read the order number. Now I look it up in the store admin and check the order date. Then I check the parcel on the courier site. It says delivered. My rules are if the courier says the parcel is lost refund the order and apologize. If the order is more than 30 days old politely decline. If the customer customer sent a photo that shows damage send a replacement. Otherwise refund the order. this order is six days old and the photo photo shows the mug is cracked so I send a replacement then I reply to the the customer to tell them

checks.name: demo case decides like the person did
checks.detail: decide() said send_replacement, the person did send_replacement

checks.name: rule test: old order declines even with damage photo
rule test: damaged photo sends replacement
rule test: exactly 30 days is not more than 30
rule test: missing values fall through to refund
rule test: lost case-insensitive with spaces

spec.title: Resolve a complaint
spec.goal: Resolve each customer complaint by checking the order and parcel status then replacing, refunding or declining with a reply.
spec.scope: Damaged-item and lost-parcel complaints; other complaint kinds must be asked about.

variables.name: item_type
variables.description: Kind of complaint in the email text
variables.question: What kind of complaint is this email?

variables.name: order_number
variables.description: Order number mentioned in the email

variables.name: customer_name
variables.description: Customer name from the email and order

variables.name: photo_shows_damage
variables.description: Whether the attached photo shows a damaged item
variables.question: Does the attached photo show a damaged item?

variables.name: order_date
variables.description: Order date on the store order page

variables.name: tracking_number
variables.description: Tracking number on the store order page

variables.name: courier_status
variables.description: Parcel status on the courier site, e.g. Delivered or Lost

steps.describe: Open the complaint email from the inbox list

expect.looks: complaint email with order number, message and photo

steps.describe: Read complaint type, order number, customer and whether photo shows damage

expect.looks: order number, customer and cracked item photo visible

steps.describe: Go to store orders to look up the order

expect.looks: order details with date and tracking number

steps.describe: Read order date and tracking number and compute age

expect.looks: order date and tracking number shown

steps.describe: Go to courier site to check parcel

rules.said: if the courier says the parcel is lost refund the order and apologize
If the order is more than 30 days old politely decline
If the customer sent a photo that shows damage send a replacement

send_replacement.describe: Send a replacement and reply that it is on its way
send_replacement.reply: Hi {{customer_name}}, sorry about the {{item_type}}. A replacement is on its way for order {{order_number}}.

steps.describe: Go to order {{order_number}} to send replacement

refund.describe: Refund the order and apologize by reply
refund.reply: Hi {{customer_name}}, sorry about order {{order_number}}. Your parcel status is {{courier_status}} so we have refunded your order.

decline.describe: Politely decline an old order with a reply
decline.reply: Hi {{customer_name}}, sorry, order {{order_number}} from {{order_date}} is {{days_since_order}} days old, so we cannot offer a replacement or refund.
